note: Threshold is 5.0pp on a 12-fixture suite: one ticket is worth 8.3pp, so 5.0 sits below the value of a single ticket and any single-ticket regression trips the gate (PLAN-assignment-2.md §5.3). The Anthropic model (claude-sonnet-5) rejects a `temperature` parameter, so trajectory determinism was not pinned but verified empirically: the clean suite returned 12/12 with the same fixtures passing across five consecutive runs. The 5.0pp margin also absorbs any residual run-to-run LLM variance while still catching a real single-ticket regression.
